- Discovery: The list above is the skills available in this session (name + description + file path). Skill bodies live on disk at the listed paths.
- Trigger rules: If the user names a skill (with `$SkillName` or plain text) OR the task clearly matches a skill's description shown above, you must use that skill for that turn. Multiple mentions mean use them all. Do not carry skills across turns unless re-mentioned.
- Missing/blocked: If a named skill isn't in the list or the path can't be read, say so briefly and continue with the best fallback.
- How to use a skill (progressive disclosure):
  1) After deciding to use a skill, open its `SKILL.md`. Read only enough to follow the workflow.
  2) When `SKILL.md` references relative paths (e.g., `scripts/foo.py`), resolve them relative to the skill directory listed above first, and only consider other paths if needed.

  - Announce which skill(s) you're using and why (one short line). If you skip an obvious skill, say why.
- Context hygiene:

  - Avoid deep reference-chasing: prefer opening only files directly linked from `SKILL.md` unless you're blocked.
  - When variants exist (frameworks, providers, domains), pick only the relevant reference file(s) and note that choice.

# RedRoom Fitness — Corporate Website

## Overview

Build a 5-page dark, bold corporate website for **RedRoom Fitness**, a premium HIIT workout brand that combines treadmill running and strength training. The site targets fitness enthusiasts and health-conscious adults aged 20–45, aiming to drive in-studio class bookings, promote a digital on-demand platform, and convert newcomers through free trial offers.

## Visual Direction

This site should feel **intense, premium, and immersive** — think dark gym lighting with dramatic red accents. Use a near-black background (`#111` or similar) with **bold red** (`#E63946` or a deep crimson) as the primary accent color. White and light gray text for contrast. Typography should be strong and modern — a condensed, uppercase sans-serif (like Oswald or Bebas Neue) for headlines, paired with a clean body font (Inter, Helvetica Neue). Generous whitespace between sections, full-bleed imagery, and large CTAs that demand attention.

## Key Priorities

- **The homepage carousel and free-trial CTA** are critical conversion elements — the carousel must feel smooth and polished, and the trial CTA should be visually dominant.
- **The Workout page's Floor/Treadmill toggle** is the core interactive moment for educating visitors — make the content switch feel seamless and intuitive.
- **Instructor filtering by location** must work correctly across all listed cities; the grid should feel dynamic when filters change.
- **The FAQ accordion** should follow single-open behavior (collapsing others when one opens).
- **Newsletter validation** should provide clear inline feedback on email input.
- The **weekly schedule table** on the workout page needs to be scannable and well-structured — this is how users decide which day to attend.

Ensure all pages share a consistent nav bar and footer. The site must be fully responsive and dark-mode by default.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.
I’m going to inspect the provided brief/JSON, then generate the 5 static pages (HTML/CSS/JS) into `/app/output` with the required interactions and shared nav/footer.

# RedRoom Fitness — The Best HIIT Workout in the World

## Brand
RedRoom Fitness is the original high-intensity interval training experience, combining treadmill running and strength training in a signature red-lit studio environment. Founded for those who demand more from their workout, RedRoom delivers results through science-backed HIIT methodology across global studio locations and a digital on-demand platform. The tone is bold, dark, and unapologetically intense.

Brand colors: `#FF0000` (RedRoom Red — primary), `#141414` (Charcoal Black — background), `#FFFFFF` (White — text/accent)

## Hero Content
Title: "TRY THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD™"
Subtitle: "Buy an exclusive first-timer 3-pack and receive a FREE Fuel Shake or Grab + Go item after your third class."
CTA: "BUY NOW" | "BOOK CLASSES"

## Top Bar Promo
Text: "The Best (Digital) Workout in the World"
CTA: "Learn More" → links to Digital Platform page

## Community Promo
Heading: "Join the Hustle"
Body: "Welcome to RedRoom. More than a workout — it's a movement. Our global community of athletes, first-timers, and everyone in between push limits together in the Red Room. Show up. Work hard. Earn your place."
CTA: "Explore the Community"

## Two Ways to Red Room
Heading: "TWO WAYS TO RED ROOM"
Option 1: **In-Studio** — "Get a (Red) Room. Step inside our signature red-lit studios for the full immersive experience. Heart-pounding music, elite instructors, and the energy of the pack."
Option 2: **Digital** — "Go Digital. Stream world-class workouts from anywhere. Same intensity, your schedule."

## The Workout — Method Overview
Heading: "THE REDROOM WAY"
Body: "Every class is a 50-minute full-body experience. You'll alternate between the treadmill and the floor, combining high-intensity cardio intervals with focused strength training. Our method is designed to maximize calorie burn, build lean muscle, and keep your metabolism elevated for hours after class. Hustle and heart set us apart."

## Floor vs. Treadmill Toggle
Heading: "Start on the Floor or the Treadmill"
**Floor:** "Dumbbells, resistance bands, and bodyweight movements target specific muscle groups each day. Our instructors guide every rep to ensure proper form and maximum results."
**Treadmill:** "From power walks to all-out sprints, the treadmill portion is designed to torch calories and build cardiovascular endurance. Every speed and incline is coach-led — all levels welcome."

## Weekly Class Schedule

| Day | Muscle Group Focus |
|---|---|
| Monday | Chest & Back |
| Tuesday | Full Body (Lower Focus) |
| Wednesday | Arms & Abs |
| Thursday | Arms & Abs |
| Friday | Full Body (Upper Focus) |
| Saturday | Full Body |

## Studio Experience
Heading: "Meet Us in the Red Room."
Body: "Red lights. Loud music. Zero distractions. Our studios are purpose-built for performance — every detail from the sound system to the lighting is engineered to push you harder. This isn't a gym. This is the Red Room."
CTA: "THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD — Don't Wait. Book Now to Get the Red Room Experience."

## Free Trial CTA
Heading: "JOIN US FOR A FREE 30 DAY TRIAL"
CTA: "Start Your Free Trial"

## Instructor Roster

Instructors are displayed as a filterable card grid. Each card shows: instructor name, home studio, and a "Book a Class" link.

**Filter by location:** All Locations · New York · Los Angeles · London · Miami · San Francisco

Sample instructors:
- **Dani Reyes** — New York
- **Marcus Cole** — Los Angeles
- **Priya Nair** — London
- **Jordan Voss** — Miami
- **Tessa Kim** — San Francisco
- **Andre Williams** — New York
- **Sofia Marquez** — Los Angeles
- **Liam Chen** — London

CTA: "Get Started Today" | "Book a Class"

## RIDE FAQ Content

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| What is RIDE x LIFT? | RIDE x LIFT is RedRoom's signature cycling class that combines a high-energy spin session with strength training on the floor. It's 50 minutes of total-body work set to motivating playlists in our red-lit studio. |
| What should I wear? | Wear moisture-wicking athletic clothing and supportive sneakers. Cycling shoes are available at the studio but not required. |
| Do I need cycling shoes? | No. We provide complimentary cycling shoes at every RIDE x LIFT studio. You're welcome to bring your own SPD-compatible shoes if you prefer. |
| How long is the class? | Each RIDE x LIFT class is 50 minutes — approximately 25 minutes on the bike and 25 minutes of strength work on the floor. |
| Is RIDE x LIFT good for beginners? | Absolutely. Our instructors coach every level. You control your resistance and speed, so the workout scales to your fitness level. |
| Where is RIDE x LIFT available? | RIDE x LIFT is currently available at our Chelsea, NYC studio with plans to expand to additional locations. |

## Digital Platform Features

Heading: "The Best (Digital) Workout in the World"

- **World Class Workouts On Your Time** — Access RedRoom's signature HIIT classes filmed with top instructors. Treadmill, floor, and full-body formats available on demand.
- **Workouts That Push You to Your Limits** — Strength, cardio, abs, stretching, and more. New classes added weekly across multiple categories and difficulty levels.
- **Unlimited Access** — One membership, unlimited streaming. No caps on how many classes you take per week.
- **30 Day Free Trial** — Try the full digital library free for 30 days. Cancel anytime.
- **Anytime, Anywhere** — Stream on your phone, tablet, laptop, or TV. Your Red Room, wherever you are.

CTA: "Join the Fit Fam Today" | "Start Your Free Trial"

## Lifestyle Carousel
A swipeable image carousel showcasing the RedRoom lifestyle — studio action shots, community events, post-workout moments, and branded apparel. Navigable via left/right arrows or swipe gestures.

## Newsletter Signup
Heading: "Newsletter Form Signup"
Body: "Stay in the know. Get workout tips, class updates, and exclusive offers delivered to your inbox."
Fields: Email address
CTA: "Subscribe"
Validation: Email format check; confirmation message on success.

## Footer Navigation
**Explore:** The Workout · Instructors · RIDE FAQ · Digital Platform · Community Events
**Company:** Our Studios · Global Expansion · Fuel Bar · Blog · Careers
**Connect:** Shop · My Account · Download the App (iOS / Android)
**Country Selector:** Dropdown with available regions (US, UK, Australia, Canada, etc.)

## Global Navigation
Primary nav items: The Workout · Instructors · RedRoom RIDE · RedRoom X (Digital) · The Community · Our Studios · First Timers
Utility nav: Book Now · Buy Classes · Shop · My Account

Built the full 5-page RedRoom Fitness corporate site in `/app/output/` (static HTML/CSS/JS; no build step).

**Pages**
- `/app/output/index.html` (Home w/ smooth lifestyle carousel + dominant free-trial CTA)
- `/app/output/the-workout.html` (Method + scannable weekly schedule table + Floor/Treadmill toggle)
- `/app/output/instructors.html` (Location filter dropdown + dynamic instructor grid)
- `/app/output/ride-faq.html` (Single-open FAQ accordion)
- `/app/output/digital-platform.html` (Digital features + strong free-trial CTA)

**Shared + Interactions**
- Shared nav/footer injected via `/app/output/partials.js`
- Global styling in `/app/output/styles.css` (dark, premium, red-accent, responsive)
- All interactions implemented in `/app/output/app.js`:
  - Home carousel: arrows, dots, keyboard, swipe
  - Workout toggle: seamless fade content swap
  - Instructor filtering: correct across all listed cities
  - FAQ accordion: single-open behavior
  - Newsletter: inline email validation + success message
  - Footer country selector: dropdown + live label

Open `/app/output/index.html` directly in a browser to start.
